name: DigiPen Institute of Technology Singapore
summary: Singapore campus of the games-technology institute, run with SIT: three four-year degrees in game software and design, applied for through SIT.

ib.text: Apply through the SIT portal: IB Diploma with grade 5 in at least two HL subjects and one SL subject. The two Computer Science degrees also need HL Maths, Physics or Computing, or SL Maths.

programmes.name: Computer Science in Real-Time Interactive Simulation
programmes.about: A software engineering degree built on mathematics, physics and computer science, where you design and program full projects, from graphical algorithms to physics engines and level editors.
programmes.ib: Needs a pass in HL Maths, Physics or Computing, or a pass in SL Maths, on top of the school-wide IB rule.

needs.note: HL Maths, Physics or Computing, or SL Maths

programmes.selectionNote: Grade 5 in two HL and one SL plus the Diploma, a 300-word personal statement and an interview if shortlisted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Computer Science in Interactive Media and Game Development
programmes.about: A hybrid programmer-designer degree: C and C++ programming, game logic, user interfaces and AI, tested across PC, mobile, console, VR and AR platforms through many individual and team projects.
programmes.ib: Needs a pass in HL Maths, Physics or Computing, or a pass in SL Maths, on top of the school-wide IB rule.

needs.note: HL Maths, Physics or Computing, or SL Maths

programmes.selectionNote: Grade 5 in two HL and one SL plus the Diploma, a 300-word personal statement and an interview if shortlisted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: User Experience and Game Design
programmes.about: A multidisciplinary degree joining user experience design theory with the humanities and social sciences, building AR and VR applications and interfaces through research, user testing and rapid prototyping.
programmes.selectionNote: Grade 5 in two HL and one SL plus the Diploma, a 300-word personal statement and an interview if shortlisted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: Applications go through the Singapore Institute of Technology portal, with a 300-word personal statement and an interview for shortlisted applicants.
The BFA in Digital Art and Animation took its final cohort in AY2025/26 and is closed to new students, even where SIT’s list still names it.
SIT’s IB page exempts international students from privately funded schools from the Mother Tongue requirement; fees are published only on the SIT website.
